question: Which materials are identified as suitable for ritual vessels in this teaching?
premises: Clay is named as a material
Bell metal and copper-metal are named
inference: Ritual vessels may be made of clay, tortoise shell, bell metal, or copper-metal.
uncertainties: The exact substance indicated by tāmralohajam may vary by tradition
